cases.context: 利用可能サービス: 1=game。未ロード。ゲーム接続中。正式な能力定義: {"name":"minecraft.obtain_item","description":"材料を必要な分だけ集めて物を用意する。採集も製作もゲームが計画する。","arguments":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["item","quantity","quantity_mode"],"properties":{"item":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z_]+$","description":"Minecraftの物のID。木のつるはし=wooden_pickaxe、石のつるはし=stone_pickaxe、オークの原木=oak_log。日本語名とIDが対応するときは確認不要。"},"quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":64},"quantity_mode":{"enum":["inventory_target","gain"]}}},"constraints":{"type":"object","required":["resource_scope","failure_policy"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"resource_scope":{"enum":["nearby","search"]},"failure_policy":{"enum":["ask","stop"]}}},"interpretation":"採集はgain、用意・製作はinventory_target。手近な材料で難しければ中止する依頼はnearbyとfailure_policy=stop、60秒。通常はsearchとask、90秒。探索や石の道具は120秒。"}
